title: IBM OM crossbar BL31 stochastic-pulse and Tiki-Taka v1 post-fault recovery
hypothesis: After rates are selected exclusively on development endpoint 89402, one fixed 55,000-example epoch of labels-only manual cross-entropy backpropagation with stochastic-compressed BL31 coincidence pulses will provide meaningful same-array compensation for the published IBM-OM corrupt-device transition on held-out endpoints 89403-89405. Meaningful recovery requires at least one of the direct slow-array or repaired-fast Tiki-Taka protocols to improve every held-out endpoint, recover at least 40% of the mean healthy-to-fault apparent-accuracy damage, and finish at or above 88% mean apparent-forward accuracy. A repaired-fast Tiki-Taka advantage is declared only if its held-out mean exceeds direct stochastic pulse-SGD by at least one percentage point. The published-fast arm is a matched sensitivity control: an absolute paired mean change of at least one percentage point relative to repaired-fast is material, with its sign reported rather than assumed.
motivation: The previous privileged continuous-shadow Adam plus final program-and-verify ceiling restored held-out apparent accuracy to 95.9%, while the older open-loop Bernoulli one-pulse Adam writer reached only 89.0%. This study removes the FP32 shadow, autograd, Adam moments, and final P&V and asks whether physical stochastic pulse trains can perform the recovery. Direct BL31 analog SGD is the ordinary on-chip update baseline. Tiki-Taka v1 adds one independently commissioned OM fast accumulation array and sequential column transfer into the same damaged slow array. The repaired-versus-published fast-array pair isolates the effect of modeled defects in that auxiliary hardware. The study compares separately development-selected protocols, not one shared-learning-rate causal intervention, and remains model-based AIHWKit-preset evidence.

arms.description: Manual label-CE BP writes stochastic-compressed BL31 coincidence pulses directly to the damaged persistent slow array at the endpoint-89402-selected q rates [0.0001,0.0001].

Manual label-CE BP accumulates stochastic-compressed pulses in an independently sampled counterfactually repaired OM fast array and transfers one sequential apparent physical-tile column per minibatch into the damaged slow array at selected q rates [0.001,0.001].
The repaired-fast Tiki-Taka protocol is repeated with the independently sampled fast OM population's published 13.48% corrupt cells retained; it inherits [0.001,0.001] without retuning.

completion_criteria: All three declared configs complete exactly once on the bias-free 784-50-10 analog-MVM--digital-ReLU--analog-MVM network. They use slow assignment 87004, slow endpoint seeds 89402-89405, the exact five one-minibatch continuous-HWA source path, the first 1000 official MNIST test examples, fixed-final evaluation, and no fresh-array transfer.

The frozen development receipt is retained verbatim: direct stochastic pulse-SGD tested shared q-rate pairs [0.0001,0.0001], [0.0003,0.0003], and [0.01,0.01] on endpoint 89402 and obtained fixed-final apparent accuracies 88.5%, 72.0%, and 52.1%, selecting [0.0001,0.0001]. After the strict-zero mask-blind fast-commissioning correction, repaired-fast Tiki-Taka tested [0.001,0.001], [0.003,0.003], and [0.01,0.01] and obtained 87.2%, 82.3%, and 78.0%, selecting [0.001,0.001]. Published-fast inherits [0.001,0.001] without tuning; its 87.1% development canary is descriptive only. All values use the fixed final state on the first 1000 validation examples; no mid-epoch state is selectable. Any rate, epoch, checkpoint, or endpoint-role change requires a new study ID.

Before recovery, every arm has exact teacher/source-q, healthy and published-companion slow populations, off-chip HWA initial/final state, per-endpoint healthy P0 persistent/apparent state, program-and-verify counters, post-fault mask and stuck-q tensor, immediate-fault persistent/apparent state, prediction, and chronology parity. Any semantic or hash mismatch invalidates the accuracy comparison.

The slow array starts counterfactually repaired and is programmed and evaluated while healthy before the immutable post-deployment companion fault is applied. The companion explicitly changes the OM preset corruption probability from its 0.0 default to 0.1348 with corrupt_devices_range=0.01. Selected cells have collapsed bounds and zero directional increments. Their persistent q=a-r is immutable during recovery; attempted writes may still refresh apparent write noise.

Every arm consumes exactly the same ordered 55,000-example ground-truth-label recovery cohort in 3438 seed-42 minibatches and exactly one epoch. Recovery uses manual full-network CE backpropagation, including the slow W2 transpose path and the digital ReLU mask. The updater receives restricted forward/transpose/pulse capabilities but no teacher logits, fault mask, autograd callback, FP32 weight shadow, Adam moments, or final program-and-verify pass.

Both update policies use stochastic-compressed coincidence pulses with desired and fixed bit-line length 31, update-BL management enabled, update management enabled, um_grad_scale=1, one endpoint-derived bit-line RNG stream, all physical tiles, and no cumulative per-cell pulse cap. The run records the configured and resolved RNG seeds, aggregate per-example and per-physical-tile bit-line statistics, clipping/management events, commanded positive and negative pulses, unique commanded cells, actual healthy persistent movement, commands to immutable cells, and stuck-site persistent immutability.

Tiki-Taka uses gamma=0, fast_lr=1, transfer_every=1 minibatch, units_in_mbatch=true, n_reads_per_transfer=1, transfer_lr=1 scaled by the declared per-layer q rate, column transfer, sequential selection, no reset, and no random slice selection. Each physical tile owns its own cursor: the two 392x50 W1 tiles and one 50x10 W2 tile each transfer one input column per minibatch, corresponding to 8.77 W1-tile passes and 68.76 W2-tile passes over 3438 updates. No global 784-column W1 cursor is permitted.

The Tiki-Taka fast array uses independent assignment 88004 and endpoint seeds 98402-98405 paired in order with the slow endpoints. Every cell receives the literal q=0 target through the same fault-blind one-pulse apparent-verify P&V interface before recovery; the controller receives neither the fast fault mask nor a support clamp/oracle. Unreachable stuck cells remain persistently immutable and may accept only through apparent noise or exhaust. Acceptance, exhaustion, persistent/apparent residuals, and commissioning pulses are reported separately from recovery pulses. Repaired-fast and published-fast differ only by retention of the fast population's sampled 0.1348-probability, 0.01-range corrupt cells. The fast array is never visible to the network forward; transfer reads its apparent state while its persistent state governs later writes.

Each endpoint reports healthy, immediate-fault, and fixed-final apparent-forward accuracy as the primary state and persistent-q accuracy as a diagnostic, with prediction/state hashes and cross-entropy. It also reports slow and fast pulse accounting, fast commissioning cost, transfer events and per-tile cursors, fast/slow apparent-persistent gaps, checkpoint reload parity, repair-cohort identity, and all fault/learner-interface receipts. Endpoint 89402 is development-only; endpoints 89403-89405 are the untouched primary cohort.

The result remains exploratory model evidence from one slow assignment and repeated endpoint/update streams. It does not establish independent-array generalization, fresh-read or retention stability, endurance safety, peripheral feasibility, absolute energy or conductance, or fabricated-device performance. The auxiliary array doubles programmable q-state storage from 39,700 to 79,400 model cells in the Tiki-Taka arms; sampled intrinsic reference subtraction remains an abstract preset feature rather than a fabricated-device count claim.
analysis_plan: Apply configuration, provenance, chronology, cohort, learner-interface, state-reload, and pulse-accounting gates before accuracy. Classify the comparison invalid if pre-recovery slow states differ across arms, if endpoint 89402 affects a post-freeze choice, if the 55,000-example streams differ, if the learner accesses a teacher/fault mask/autograd/shadow/Adam, or if reported pulse totals fail to reconcile with plant counters.

Exclude endpoint 89402 from every primary statistic. For held-out endpoints 89403-89405, report each arm's healthy, immediate-fault, and fixed-final apparent accuracy; arithmetic mean and full range; fault damage; recovery gain; recovery fraction gain/(healthy-faulted) when damage is positive; and distance from healthy. Report persistent-q versions beside, but never in place of, apparent-forward results.

Call an on-chip stochastic protocol meaningfully reparative only if every held-out endpoint improves, mean recovery fraction is at least 0.40, and mean final apparent accuracy is at least 88%. Report whether direct or repaired-fast Tiki-Taka meets all three gates. Do not round a failing threshold upward or use a mid-epoch checkpoint.

Compare repaired-fast Tiki-Taka with direct pulse-SGD endpoint by endpoint and by paired held-out mean. Call a Tiki-Taka advantage only if repaired-fast exceeds direct by at least 1.0 percentage point in mean final apparent accuracy. Because their q rates were selected separately on development, label this a best-development-selected protocol comparison rather than a shared-rate causal effect.

Compare published-fast with repaired-fast using the inherited identical Tiki-Taka rate and schedule. Report the paired mean and endpoint range for final apparent accuracy, recovery gain, fast/slow pulse counts, transfer events, fast initialization error, and fast apparent-persistent state gaps. Call the fast-defect effect material when the absolute paired mean final-accuracy difference is at least 1.0 percentage point and report its observed sign; do not assume defects must hurt after seeing the development canary.

Audit mechanism with bit-line-length distributions, probability/management clipping, commanded pulses per layer and per array, commands to immutable versus programmable cells, actual healthy persistent movement, fast commissioning pulses, transfer cursor wraps, and stuck-site immutability. A command to a stuck site is not a repaired device; any accuracy recovery must be attributed to compensation by programmable cells.

Report endpoint 89402 only in a separate development table containing the exact candidate rates, strict-zero fixed-final apparent outcomes, and selected values. Do not pool it with held-out evidence, select a mid-epoch state, or use the published-fast development canary to retune that arm.

Compare the held-out on-chip results descriptively with the prior privileged continuous-shadow plus final-P&V ceiling only after exact P0/fault parity is verified. Do not describe parity with that ceiling as proof of retention-stable on-chip repair, and do not update the experimental manifest until artifact-verified coverage and human scientific review are complete.
